$schema-note: Machine-readable emitted security-policy baseline for APP-01 M1. src/security/header-values.js independently enforces the reviewed contract so this data cannot silently widen. Any policy change must update baseline, contract, tests, security rationale and applicable ADR in one reviewed change.

connect_src_policy.note: Only reviewed HTTPS public origins or explicit HTTP loopback development origins may be appended. Wildcards, scheme sources, private/link-local IP literals, paths and noncanonical hosts are rejected. DNS resolution and redirect checks remain runtime/ADR-003 obligations.
